title: Weak Schur number WS(5), lower bound
statement: Colour 1, 2, ..., n with 5 colours so that no colour holds a solution of x + y = z with x != y, with n as large as possible; it shows WS(5) >= n. The best known lower bound is WS(5) >= 207, by Rowley (2025, in OEIS A072842); a colouring of 1..208 or more would improve it.
submission: Text file: the colours of 1..n in order, digits 0..4 (whitespace ignored).
score: n, the length of the colouring; it proves WS(5) >= n (larger is better)

best_known.source: WS(5) >= 207: Rowley (2025, in OEIS A072842), in Leaps in Bounds (github.com/daniel-munro/leaps-in-bounds), data at commit 4521e13 (8 Nov 2026); read 8 Nov 2026

provenance.keeper: Leaps in Bounds, Schur and weak Schur numbers
